calendar.matters:
Hearing On Petition For Change Of Name Filed By Petitioner Rachel Anne Becker.
Off Calendar Sep-09-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Frank Drago, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Rachel Anne Becker was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Service in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Benjamin Becker Shine.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

Hearing On Petition For Change Of Name Filed By Petitioner Rachel Anne Becker.
Off Calendar Sep-02-2008 Continued To Sep-09-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Bruce E. Chan, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, 33689.

Petitioner Rachel Ann Becker was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file, but due to a clerical error, the Court is unable to proceed with today's hearing.

Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name is continued to September 9, 2008 @ 9:00 a.m. in Department 218.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
